name: Yamaha 689cc CP2 (MT-07 / Tracer 7 / XSR700 / Ténéré 700 / R7)
source: Yamaha EU periodic maintenance chart for CP2 models (10,000 km / 12 mo service), summarised.

items.name: Engine oil & filter
items.notes: Yamaha: every 10,000 km (6,000 mi) / 12 months. Your 5k rule sits inside that.

items.name: Service inspection (brakes, tyres, wheels, suspension, cables, lights, idle/throttle sync)
Drive chain clean, lube & adjust
items.notes: Also every ~500 mi and after rain. Replace chain and sprockets as a set.

items.name: Fork oil
items.notes: Not strictly in Yamaha's chart, but worth doing.
